note: Card text pulled word-for-word from aruljohn/Bible-kjv; whole verses only.

scenes.title: The Revelation is given
scenes.visual: Dawn breaking over a calm sea and the rocky shore of Patmos; vast gold-edged clouds opening like curtains; a robed man (John) kneeling small on the rocks, face lifted; a faint scroll of light unrolling in the sky.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in; clouds part and drift; light rays brighten; waves lap; John's robe stirs.
scenes.card_text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

scenes.title: Seven golden lampstands
scenes.visual: Night on Patmos; a circle of seven tall golden branched lampstands blazing with true flame (ancient oil lampstands, not chess pieces); in the midst a radiant robed figure, hair white as wool, eyes like flame, seven stars in his right hand, a sword of light from his mouth; John on the ground before him.
scenes.motion: Flames flicker, stars shimmer in the raised hand, slow orbit around the circle of light, robe and hair moving.
scenes.card_text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

scenes.title: Fear not
scenes.visual: Close on John fallen like a dead man at the feet; a great hand of light laid gently on his shoulder; gold light flooding across dark stone; seven stars glittering above.
scenes.motion: Light pulses warm; dust motes drift; slow push-in on the hand.
scenes.card_text: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

scenes.title: Ephesus: first love
scenes.visual: A great ancient harbor city at dusk with one lampstand burning low in a marble street; a faithful figure holding a flame close; the Tree of Life glowing gold in the distance beyond the city.
scenes.motion: Flame steadies and brightens; slow dolly toward the tree of light.
scenes.card_text: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

scenes.title: Smyrna: a crown of life
scenes.visual: A narrow prison stair in shadow; one steadfast figure standing unbowed in a shaft of light; a golden crown of light descending from above.
scenes.motion: Crown descends slowly; chains fall away in sparks; light brightens.
scenes.card_text: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

scenes.title: Pergamos: the sword of my mouth
scenes.visual: A hill-city with a dark throne-like altar on the heights; a brilliant two-edged sword of light cutting the storm sky; white stone glowing in an open palm.
scenes.motion: Storm clouds split along the sword; lightning veins fade to gold; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

scenes.title: Thyatira: the morning star
scenes.visual: A forge-city glowing orange with furnace fire; above it one bright morning star rising over the horizon, rays touching the faithful.
scenes.motion: Embers rise; the star climbs and brightens; slow crane up.
scenes.card_text: And I will give him the morning star.

scenes.title: Sardis: white raiment
scenes.visual: A pale stone city in ashen dusk; one figure stepping forward as a pure white robe unfurls around them, a book of life glowing open in the sky.
scenes.motion: Robe billows and brightens; ash drifts; light spreads across the city.
scenes.card_text: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

scenes.title: Philadelphia: the open door
scenes.visual: A mountain temple with a tall gate of gold opening outward, brilliant light pouring through; a small figure with a key of light walking toward it, pillar of gold rising behind.
scenes.motion: Door swings wide; light floods the frame; slow push-in toward the gate.
scenes.card_text: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

scenes.title: Laodicea: I stand at the door
scenes.visual: A humble wooden door at night under a starry sky, a luminous robed figure standing outside with one hand raised to knock, warm lamp-glow from a table set inside.
scenes.motion: Knock gesture, lamp warms, slow push-in to the door and the lit table.
scenes.card_text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

scenes.title: The throne in heaven
scenes.visual: An open door in the sky; a throne of light ringed by an emerald rainbow; twenty-four elders in white with gold crowns on small thrones; a sea of glass before it; seven lamps of fire burning.
scenes.motion: Rainbow shimmers, lamp flames dance, slow rise up toward the throne.
scenes.card_text: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

scenes.title: Holy, holy, holy
scenes.visual: Four living creatures (lion, ox, man-faced, eagle) full of eyes around the throne with six wings each; elders casting golden crowns before the throne; waves of light rolling outward.
scenes.motion: Wings beat slowly; crowns cast and fall into light; rotating push-in.
scenes.card_text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, LORD God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

scenes.title: The Lion and the Lamb
scenes.visual: A sealed scroll in a hand on the throne; a mighty Lion of gold standing in the center turning into a Lamb that stands as slain, seven horns and seven eyes of light.
scenes.motion: Lion and Lamb dissolve into each other; seals glow; slow push-in on the scroll.
scenes.card_text: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

scenes.title: Worthy is the Lamb
scenes.visual: A vast multitude of angels and elders in rings of light, harps and golden bowls of incense rising, voices as waves of gold sound filling heaven.
scenes.motion: Rings of angels rotate slowly; incense smoke curls up; light swells.
scenes.card_text: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

scenes.title: The white horse
scenes.visual: A rider on a white horse bursting from clouds, a bow in hand and a crown being given, golden light behind, storm sky ahead.
scenes.motion: Horse gallops forward through clouds, mane and cloak streaming; slow tracking shot.
scenes.card_text: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

scenes.title: The red, black and pale horses
scenes.visual: Three horses in a dark stormy sky: fiery red with a great sword, black with a balance of scales, pale with a rider named Death; the earth below shadowed and silent.
scenes.motion: Horses ride across the frame in turn; storm clouds roil; red light flares; slow pan.
scenes.card_text: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

scenes.title: Souls under the altar
scenes.visual: A great altar in heaven with white-robed souls beneath, each given a white robe; soft light and quiet; one gentle voice asking 'how long'.
scenes.motion: White robes glow and settle; light warms; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

scenes.title: The sixth seal
scenes.visual: Earth shaking, sun black as sackcloth, moon blood-red, stars falling like figs from a tree, the heaven rolling up like a scroll, kings and mighty men hiding in mountains.
scenes.motion: Stars fall in slow streaks; sky rolls up; earth trembles; dark-to-red pulse.
scenes.card_text: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

scenes.title: Four angels, the seal of God
scenes.visual: Four angels at the four corners of the earth holding back the winds; another angel rising from the east with the seal of the living God, a glowing mark of gold on foreheads.
scenes.motion: Winds held in swirling gold ribbons; seal angel ascends; slow orbit.
scenes.card_text: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

scenes.title: The great multitude
scenes.visual: An uncountable multitude in white robes with palm branches before the throne, from every nation, a river of light flowing down; the Lamb leading them to fountains.
scenes.motion: Palms sway; multitude waves like a field; slow crane over the crowd.
scenes.card_text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

scenes.title: Silence in heaven
scenes.visual: Absolute stillness: seven angels with trumpets standing in a pale hush; another angel at a golden altar with a censer, incense smoke rising in a single column.
scenes.motion: Almost still: smoke column rises, gentle light pulse, very slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

scenes.title: The first four trumpets
scenes.visual: Hail and fire mingled with blood falling on the earth; a burning mountain cast into the sea; a great star called Wormwood falling on the rivers; an eagle flying through mid-heaven crying woe.
scenes.motion: Fire hail falls; star trails a comet tail; eagle crosses the frame.
scenes.card_text: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

scenes.title: The fifth trumpet
scenes.visual: A star fallen with the key to the bottomless pit; smoke rising like a furnace darkening the sun; locusts like armored horses with crowns, a fury of wings.
scenes.motion: Smoke billows upward; swarm streams across the sky; dim sun flicker.
scenes.card_text: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

scenes.title: The sixth trumpet
scenes.visual: A vast host of horsemen with breastplates of fire, jacinth and brimstone, lion-headed horses breathing fire and smoke across a darkened river Euphrates.
scenes.motion: Fire and smoke churn; riders surge across the plain; slow tracking shot.
scenes.card_text: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

scenes.title: The mighty angel and the little book
scenes.visual: A mighty angel clothed with a cloud, a rainbow on his head, face like the sun, feet as pillars of fire, one foot on the sea and one on the land, a little open book in his hand.
scenes.motion: Cloud swirls; rainbow brightens; slow low-angle rise up the angel.
scenes.card_text: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

scenes.title: The two witnesses
scenes.visual: Two witnesses in sackcloth standing in a great city street, two olive trees and two lampstands of fire beside them; fire from their mouths; later fallen and then raised, a cloud receiving them.
scenes.motion: Lamp flames burn; witnesses stand still; light rises as they are lifted; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

scenes.title: The kingdoms of our Lord
scenes.visual: The seventh trumpet sounds; the temple of God opened in heaven, the ark of his covenant seen in a flood of light, lightning, voices, thunder, an earthquake and great hail.
scenes.motion: Light blooms; lightning flashes silently; slow push-in on the ark.
scenes.card_text: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

scenes.title: The woman and the dragon
scenes.visual: A woman clothed with the sun, the moon under her feet, a crown of twelve stars; a great red dragon with seven heads and ten crowns sweeping stars from the sky before her, her child caught up to God.
scenes.motion: Sun rays pulse; stars fall; dragon coils; child lifted in light; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

scenes.title: War in heaven
scenes.visual: Michael and his angels in white-gold armor fighting the dragon and his fallen angels, the dragon cast down like a falling fire, heaven rejoicing above.
scenes.motion: Wings and swords of light clash; dragon falls in slow arc; light grows above.
scenes.card_text: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

scenes.title: The woman flees
scenes.visual: The woman given two wings of a great eagle, flying over a wilderness to her place of safety; the dragon's flood of water swallowed by the earth.
scenes.motion: Wings beat; flood sinks into cracked earth; slow tracking over desert.
scenes.card_text: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

scenes.title: The beast from the sea
scenes.visual: A beast rising from a black sea at dusk with seven heads, ten horns and ten crowns, like a leopard with feet of a bear and mouth of a lion; crowds in awe below; one head wounded and healed.
scenes.motion: Waves heave; heads sway; dark-to-red glow; slow low-angle push-in.
scenes.card_text: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

scenes.title: The beast from the earth
scenes.visual: A second beast rising from the earth with two horns like a lamb, speaking as a dragon; fire called down from heaven; a great image; the mark and the number glowing and then breaking apart.
scenes.motion: Fire falls; mark glows dim and fractures; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

scenes.title: The Lamb on Mount Sion
scenes.visual: The Lamb standing on Mount Sion with a hundred forty and four thousand holding harps, the Father's name bright on their foreheads, a sound of many waters and harpers.
scenes.motion: Harps shimmer; river of light flows; slow crane up.
scenes.card_text: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father’s name written in their foreheads.

scenes.title: The three angels
scenes.visual: An angel flying in mid-heaven with the everlasting gospel; a second proclaiming Babylon fallen; a third warning; below, a voice from heaven: Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord.
scenes.motion: Angels cross the sky in turn; scroll of light unrolls; slow tilt up.
scenes.card_text: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

scenes.title: The harvest of the earth
scenes.visual: A white cloud; upon it one like the Son of man with a golden crown and a sharp sickle; the earth's harvest ripe; the winepress outside the city, rivers up to the horses' bridles.
scenes.motion: Clouds roll; sickle gleams; fields ripple; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

scenes.title: The sea of glass
scenes.visual: A sea of glass mingled with fire; the victorious standing on it with harps of God singing the song of Moses and the Lamb; seven angels in pure white linen with golden girdles; the temple filling with smoke from the glory of God.
scenes.motion: Fire glints under glass; harps glow; temple smoke rises; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

scenes.title: The first five vials
scenes.visual: Seven angels pouring golden bowls on the earth: grievous sores, sea like the blood of a dead man, rivers to blood, scorching sun, the seat of the beast darkened; an angel of the waters crying righteous.
scenes.motion: Bowls tip and pour; water turns red; sky darkens; slow pan.
scenes.card_text: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.

scenes.title: The sixth and seventh vials, Armageddon
scenes.visual: The great river Euphrates drying up; three unclean spirits like frogs gathering kings to a great valley; the seventh vial, a great voice from the throne 'It is done', lightning, earthquake, great hail of a talent.
scenes.motion: River dries; spirits gather; lightning storm; slow push-in on the valley.
scenes.card_text: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

scenes.title: Mystery Babylon
scenes.visual: A glittering gold and scarlet city on seven hills rising out of water; a scarlet beast carrying a fabulous veiled queen-figure holding a golden cup; kings bowing; the Lamb and his called, chosen and faithful standing apart in white.
scenes.motion: Gold and scarlet shimmer; beast sways; white host advances; slow tilt up.
scenes.card_text: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

scenes.title: Babylon is fallen
scenes.visual: A mighty angel lighting the earth with glory; a magnificent merchant city burning with smoke rising; ships of merchants on the horizon; an angel hurling a great millstone into the sea.
scenes.motion: City burns; smoke towers; millstone sinks in a ring of waves; slow crane back.
scenes.card_text: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

scenes.title: Alleluia, the marriage of the Lamb
scenes.visual: A vast heavenly multitude with the sound of many waters and mighty thunderings; the bride clothed in fine linen, clean and white; a golden table prepared; angel with John falling at his feet.
scenes.motion: Waves of light roll outward; linen shimmers; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

scenes.title: Faithful and True
scenes.visual: Heaven opened; a rider on a white horse with eyes like a flame of fire, many crowns, a vesture dipped in blood, armies of heaven in white linen following on white horses; a sharp sword of light from his mouth; an angel standing in the sun.
scenes.motion: Horses surge forward in slow motion; crowns glint; slow tracking shot.
scenes.card_text: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

scenes.title: The dragon bound
scenes.visual: An angel with the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain laying hold of the dragon, binding him a thousand years and sealing him in the pit; thrones with judges and the first resurrection in white.
scenes.motion: Chain tightens in sparks; pit seals with light; thrones brighten; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

scenes.title: Fire from God out of heaven
scenes.visual: Satan loosed for a little season gathering Gog and Magog like the sand of the sea around the camp of the saints; fire from God out of heaven devouring them; the devil cast into the lake of fire.
scenes.motion: Armies surge and then burn out in white fire; slow crane up.
scenes.card_text: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

scenes.title: The great white throne
scenes.visual: A great white throne in a void; earth and heaven fleeing away from the face of him that sat on it; the dead small and great standing before God; books opened; the book of life glowing.
scenes.motion: Heaven and earth dissolve in light; books open; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

scenes.title: A new heaven and a new earth
scenes.visual: A new heaven and earth, no more sea; the holy city coming down from God out of heaven as a bride adorned; the throne in the midst; God wiping away all tears; Alpha and Omega.
scenes.motion: Clouds clear; city descends slowly in a blaze of gold; tears turn to light; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

scenes.title: The holy city, the Lamb is the light
scenes.visual: A great high mountain; the holy Jerusalem with walls of jasper, twelve gates each a single pearl, twelve foundations of precious stones, streets of pure gold like transparent glass; no sun, no moon, the Lamb is the light.
scenes.motion: Jewel colors shift slowly across the walls; gates glow; slow orbit around the city.
scenes.card_text: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

scenes.title: The river of life
scenes.visual: A pure river of water of life clear as crystal flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb down the middle of the street of gold; the tree of life on either side with twelve manner of fruits; no night there.
scenes.motion: River flows toward the viewer; leaves sway; light warms; slow push-in.
scenes.card_text: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

scenes.title: Behold, I come quickly
scenes.visual: An angel with John at the feet; a radiant figure at the horizon, the bright and morning star; the Spirit and the bride saying Come; hands reaching for the water of life freely.
scenes.motion: Morning star rises; hands reach; river light brightens; slow crane up.
scenes.card_text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

scenes.title: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ
scenes.visual: The sealed book of life closing in a warm gold light; a quiet shoreline at dawn like the first scene; John standing, face lifted to a brightening sky, the sun rising over the sea.
scenes.motion: Slow push-in; sunrise brightens; waves lap; fade to gold.
scenes.card_text: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
